# Simple RC4: compute ciphertext hex for plaintext invalid UTF-8 bytes under key 'key'
def rc4(key, data):
    S=list(range(256)); j=0; out=[]
    key=list(key)
    for i in range(256):
        j=(j+S[i]+key[i%len(key)])&255
        S[i],S[j]=S[j],S[i]
    i=j=0
    for b in data:
        i=(i+1)&255; j=(j+S[i])&255
        S[i],S[j]=S[j],S[i]
        K=S[(S[i]+S[j])&255]
        out.append(b^K)
    return bytes(out)
for pt in [b'\xff', b'\xc0\x80', b'\xed\xa0\x80', b'abc\xffdef']:
    print(pt, rc4(b'key', pt).hex())
